posts.post: If you could only wear one outfit for the rest of your life what is it and why. I am designing the STRAYED uniform to be the only thing you need in your closet. Don't give me generic answers. Be specific about the cut and the material.

The obsession with fast fashion is rotting your style. You buy new clothes every month because nothing you own actually lasts or looks good. I am building a brand that treats your wardrobe like an investment. What is the one item you own that you will never get rid of.
